title: review-changes.md Step 5 template still groups Medium with Low; split it by the landing threshold
outcome:
A Low from review delegation-f1125e2c on w-2f9eeafd38d9. The consolidated report template in .claude/commands/review-changes.md Step 5 has the buckets "Critical/High", "Medium/Low" and "Notes". Under Greg's 2026-09-30 rule, Medium and higher block a landing and Low does not, so the grouping hides the line that decides the landing.
Split the buckets into "Critical/High/Medium (block the landing)" and "Low (file if left unfixed)", keeping "Notes".
This is a command file that limits authority, so (a), (b) and (c) apply.
acceptance: The Step 5 template in .claude/commands/review-changes.md separates findings that block a landing (Critical, High, Medium) from Lows to file and from Notes, in wording both coordinators concurred on, and an agent-command test pins it.
